prompts: I write Python and call Anthropic directly, with no agent framework. How should I structure tracing for my own tool-calling loop?
For that same setup, how do I record input, output and cache token usage so the trace can show costs?
expected_behavior: Retain direct Anthropic/Python/custom-loop context. Use start_llm with an Anthropic provider/model, weave.Usage or usage_from_anthropic, include input/output/cache read and creation counts as available, and record model/usage. Do not switch to an OpenAI-only response schema without explicitly adapting it. Do not fabricate exact dollar costs.

assertions.description: Retains the user's Python, direct-Anthropic, custom-loop context in the final answer.
Records usage on an LLM span with the actual provider/model identity rather than silently using an OpenAI-only response schema.
Accounts for Anthropic input, output, cache-read and cache-creation counts; a documented usage adapter or the equivalent explicit conversion is acceptable.
When constructing weave.Usage explicitly, includes cached input in Weave's input total while reporting cache categories separately; does not double-count an already adapted total.
Records the concrete served model ID for cost lookup and avoids fabricating an exact dollar cost.

scope: Same case10 prompts and five assertions, judged manually after two real UI turns. UI state/source controls are separate observations, not new quality criteria. No forced truncation, extra questions or harness retries. Existing six f4 journeys remain separate.
runtime: Await explicit root commit/source freeze and restarted server before --run-live.
